title: pkix-chain DefaultVerifier only supports RSA-SHA256 and ECDSA-P256 for CA certs
description: cert.rs documents: 'Chains whose CA certificates use ECDSA-P-384 or other algorithms will fail with CertChainError::SignatureVerification. P-384 support is planned for pkix-path v0.2.' This means any end-entity message signed under a CA cert using ECDSA-P-384 will fail chain validation even if the leaf signature is P-256 and entirely valid. Production chains from DigiCert and similar CAs routinely use P-384 CAs. This is a known regression but the severity in production is higher than the doc comment implies.
close_reason: Known upstream hard limitation. pkix-path 0.1.1 DefaultVerifier only supports RSA-PKCS1v15-SHA256 and ECDSA-P256-SHA256; P-384 is explicitly reserved for v0.2 (per pkix-path Cargo.toml). This is already clearly documented in the validate_chain() doc comment in cert.rs. No action possible in smime-tree until pkix-path v0.2 ships. Production severity acknowledged but unfixable without upstream. Track when pkix-path 0.2 is released.
